description: Two clock dividers, each counting its own clock into four divisions and combining them at three outputs

params.text: Sets how that section's dividers are combined at its outputs: OR passes a trigger from either divider, XOR passes one only when the two differ
Sets that divider's count, from one clock pulse to fifteen for each trigger it sends
Switches that divider on and off; switched off it sends nothing

inputs.text: The clock that section's four dividers count
Adds to that divider's count, a volt to each step, and the result is held between 1 and 15

outputs.text: All four dividers of that section combined as the mode switch sets, at 10V
The first two dividers of that section combined as the mode switch sets, at 10V
The last two dividers of that section combined as the mode switch sets, at 10V

notes: all eight dividers start switched off, and nothing reaches the outputs until at least one of them is switched on

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
